shots.summary: Lắp ráp bộ set
Good morning. I have forty seven tasks today.
Forty seven? That is not a list. That is a novel.
I will just start with the easy ones.
Classic mistake. Easy tasks feel great. They change nothing.
But I answered twelve emails!
And the bug from Monday?
It is still. Emotionally. In progress.
In my day, we had one task. Build the bridge.
Grandma Lin? Since when are you here?
Since nineteen seventy one. I am always here.
Let me show you the data. Look at this chart.
One hard task in the morning. Huge progress.
Forty small tasks. Tiny progress. Big tiredness.
So the list is lying to me?
The list is not lying. You are hiding behind it.
Wow. That was very personal.
Step one. Pick the scary task.
Before the inbox? That is illegal.
It is not illegal. It is just uncomfortable.
Fine. The scary task is the Monday bug.
How long will it take?
Between ten minutes and the rest of my life.
Then set a timer. Ninety minutes. No phone.
No phone? What if something happens?
Something will happen. Your work.
Okay. Timer on. Phone in the drawer.
Good. Now the small tasks go in one batch. After lunch.
Emails, messages, meetings. One block. Done.
Wait. I fixed it. The bug is gone!
In how long?
Eleven minutes.
Eleven minutes. After three days of avoiding it.
I feel betrayed by my own brain.
Welcome to productivity.
So what do I do with the other forty six tasks?
Delete half. Nobody will notice.
Is that true?
I deleted my calendar in two thousand five. Still alive.
Repeat? Every day? Forever?
Only on days you want things done.
That is most days. Unfortunately.
Here is the secret. Start before you feel ready.
I never feel ready.
Perfect. Then you can start any time.
And when you finish the scary task, celebrate.
With coffee?
With one coffee. Not four.
Three. Final offer.
Two. And you clean my keyboard.
Deal. Step four. Bribe Grandma Lin.
Step five. Tomorrow, repeat.
